title: StackJob
description: A unit of work the Stack drives for Home: a generator render (image, video, music), a download, an engine install. Submitted once, watched on the event feed (job.progress, job.done), cancelled by id, its result fetched by id. A generator job waits in its role's queue (`position`, 1-based) until the governor admits it; a job the budget refuses fails with the governor's reason.

companion_id.description: The companion that asked for this job, recording who worked.

kind.description: The runner's kind: a generator role id (`image`, `music`), or a Stack task (`model.install`, `engine.install`, `engine.stage`), or a media job (MEDIA-SPEC-01: `media.fetch`, `media.probe`, `media.transcode`, `media.preview`, `media.chapter_snap`, `media.tts`), each run on the Stack's one idle lane.

role.description: The role the job serves, when it serves one.

bytesPerSecond.description: Smoothed transfer rate in bytes per second, when available.

items.description: Optional per-file progress for multi-file downloads.

status.description: A short phrase for the current step (`downloading`, `waiting for memory`, `rendering`).

position.description: The job's place in its role's queue while `queued`, null otherwise.

result.description: What the runner returned when `done`; a generator returns `{ images: [{ b64_json }] }`.

reason.description: Why the job failed or was cancelled.

tier.description: TIER-SPEC-01. The tier the job ran or runs at, when it has one. Absent or null for a task with no tier (a download).

window.description: TIER-SPEC-01. The id of the Max window this job runs inside, so chained jobs share one lowering. Null when no window applies.

tier_reason.description: TIER-SPEC-01. A short code for why the job is not at the tier asked for (`tier_reduced`, `profile_lowered`, `max_window`, `quiet_wait`, `fair_share`), or null. A reason code, never a person's words.

profile.description: TIER-SPEC-01. The profile the job actually got, as counts only. No app, person or model names (making-space note section 9).

lowered.description: Categories lowered to a lower tier for this job.

queued.description: Categories held back with a reason while this job ran.

off.description: Categories switched off while this job ran.

closed_apps.description: How many apps Home closed for the job. A count only; names stay in memory for the job's life.

closed_bytes.description: About how many bytes closing those apps freed.
